text:
Evan Park: Heads-up — Tidelake (channel partner) proposed special onboarding: 18-month prepaid commit $200,000, 22% reseller discount on seat pricing for first 12 months, 12% rev-share on net revenue, and net-60 invoicing. They want monthly payouts. Need finance + legal quick sign-off. cc @Mina Alvarez @Omar Khalid

Mina Alvarez: Quick Qs — payment method? recognition schedule? who signed off on the usage profile? We need COGS to run gross margin impact.

Evan Park: Wiring via ACH. Plan: defer $200k and recognize monthly over 18 months. Infra estimated COGS ~ $45k for hosted usage (p50 token sim). Partner claims this drives 3 enterprise pilots.

Omar Khalid: Accounting notes: we'll create Deferred Revenue (2100) and a Reseller Liability (5130) for rev-share reserves. Need to know if rev-share is before or after platform/transaction fees (net vs gross). Also net-60 on prepaid exposure > $150k needs treasury OK.

Rhea Kapoor: Legal: we need an addendum with rev-share calc, tax withholding, KYC, and audit rights. Also include clause limiting promotional discounts to the first 12 months and a clawback if partner breaches. I can draft once commercial terms locked.

Evan Park: Tidelake confirms rev-share calculated on net after platform fees and taxes. They also request earlier access to seats during onboarding month 0; ops asked for proof of wire before provisioning.

Mina Alvarez: Guardrails proposal: (1) reserve 30% of prepaid into 5130 until first reconciliation, (2) cap rev-share payouts to max 40% of gross margin, (3) require wire confirmation before provisioning. If accepted I can approve the one-off discount + net-60.

Omar Khalid: Treasury reviewed: exposure $200k with net-60 is higher than standard. Provisional approval conditional on reserve 30% and an executed addendum with KYC and tax clause. Approve 22% reseller discount (12 months), net-60 billing, monthly payouts, prepaid recognition over 18 months, rev-share reserve 30%. :white_check_mark:

Evan Park: Great, thanks. Rhea please loop Partnerships for addendum review. I'll attach SOW and wiring instructions to the BILL ticket. billing-bot create plan tag 'tidelake-v2-prepaid'.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-5021: "Tidelake prepaid + reseller terms" — tasks: create plan_id 'tidelake-v2-prepaid', invoice template with promo line, map GL 5130 for reseller reserve. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-5021. Next steps: legal signoff -> billing config -> create customer credit account -> schedule monthly payout workflow. ETA 3 business days for initial config.

Rhea Kapoor: I'll draft the addendum and share for internal review. Evan, please attach SOW and wire proof to BILL-5021.

Evan Park: Will attach docs now and ping Partnerships. Thanks everyone :pray:
